description_en: Invokes this operation to query the list of over-the-air update upgrade packages
description_zh: 调用该接口查询OTA升级包列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-ota-firmware --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a19mzPZ0000 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --dest-version 4.0.0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOTAFirmware

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs.

If you specify this parameter, the over-the-air update upgrade packages of the specified product are queried. If you do not specify this parameter, all over-the-air update upgrade packages of the current Alibaba Cloud account are returned
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包所属产品的**ProductKey**。

传入该参数，则查询指定产品下的OTA升级包列表；不传入此参数，则返回当前阿里云账号下的所有OTA升级包列表
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The number of firmware entries to display on each page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的固件数量。最大限制为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to display from the returned results. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The version number of the over-the-air update upgrade package. If you specify this parameter, the over-the-air update upgrade package with the specified version number is queried
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级包版本号。传入该参数，则查询版本号为指定版本号的OTA升级包
parameters.name: dest_version
